contextSlice.reason: D0016 requires deterministic selection/dependency/fallback and representative correctness/quality evidence before a model-visible semantic reduction can be selected.

persistentCas.reason: No cross-worker reuse requirement is established; persistent publication/corruption/GC/migration contracts remain evidence-gated.

externalProvider.reason: D0018 owns provider authentication, egress, tokenizer/billing/retry/privacy behavior; local fixture evidence cannot qualify those claims.

semanticGate.contextSlice: not-selected: deterministic dependency/completeness/quality contract and representative full-context comparison are absent

interpretation.bundleReference: reduces parent-to-receiver request bytes while preserving full receiver-visible context; fresh receivers still pay full reference resolution/storage reads and process starts
interpretation.manifestContentReference: reduces request bytes but adds per-file reference-resolution work; file-count-sensitive complexity must earn its value over a single immutable bundle
interpretation.warmInline: reduces process starts but retains full request bytes and full-context disclosure; one warm receiver is also a capacity/queue owner rather than a free optimization
interpretation.streamingInline: preserves request bytes and full receiver parse in this bounded model; it may reduce peak copies only after a source-shaped streaming builder exists, so no product memory claim is made here
interpretation.warmBundleReference: combines low request bytes with receiver-side exact-digest cache reuse after the first resolution; restart is cold and must re-resolve the immutable bundle
